b: Suntex Marinas, a leading owner and operator of recreational marinas across the United States, is advancing its commitment to innovation and responsible waterfront development through a collaboration with FlyTahoe at Tahoe Keys Marina in South Lake Tahoe, California.

With electrical infrastructure serving all 305 slips, Tahoe Keys Marina provides a foundation for supporting evolving vessel technologies and the growing interest in electric recreational boating. The collaboration with FlyTahoe introduces additional infrastructure designed to support DC fast-charging capabilities, demonstrating how strategic marina investments can help bring emerging marine technologies into real-world operations.

As part of the initiative, a new marine power pedestal has been installed to support FlyTahoe’s planned electric vessel operations. The installation features a 100-amp, 480-volt, three-phase electrical supply designed to accommodate a compatible movable DC fast charger, creating opportunities for future electric vessel operations and infrastructure development.

“We are pleased to welcome FlyTahoe to Tahoe Keys Marina as we continue to prioritize responsible waterfront development across our national portfolio,” said David Filler, Chief Development Officer of Suntex Marinas. “This collaboration brings emerging technologies into real-world marina operations, creating opportunities to advance sustainable solutions and shape the future of recreational boating across the country.”

Beyond Lake Tahoe, the collaboration reflects Suntex’s broader development strategy of evaluating innovative infrastructure, engaging technology partners, and identifying scalable solutions that may benefit marina operations and boating communities nationwide.

“Working with Suntex Marinas provides an opportunity to connect emerging electric vessel technology with established marina infrastructure,” said Ryan Meinzer, Founder & CEO of FlyTahoe. “Tahoe Keys Marina offers an important foundation for our planned operations and demonstrates how collaboration between marina operators and technology innovators can help accelerate the adoption of sustainable marine transportation – connecting shoreline communities while helping preserve the lake at their heart.”

Through continued investment in marina infrastructure and strategic industry relationships, Suntex is positioning its properties to accommodate changing customer expectations, support new marine technologies, and contribute to the long-term evolution of recreational boating.

Suntex Marinas owns and operates a national network of over 100 premier marina properties across the United States. With more than a century of combined experience, Suntex specializes in the acquisition, development, and management of high-quality marinas. The company is recognized for its commitment to exceptional customer service, experienced on-site teams, and strong community engagement delivering elevated, memorable experiences for boaters on the water. www.suntex.com

Featuring America’s first electric flying ferry, FlyTahoe is developing a sustainable water transit network on Lake Tahoe. Its vision is to cut travel time in half for the 20,000 daily drivers traveling between North and South Tahoe while preserving the lake’s clarity by eliminating road sediment and emissions. By delivering 10x operational efficiency gains through electric hydrofoil technology, the model aims to unlock profitability while making flying across Lake Tahoe cheaper than driving around it. FlyTahoe’s planned electric flying ferry is highlighted in the Lake Tahoe Regional Transportation Plan. Learn more at flytahoe.com.
